name: dreaming-course-pipeline
description: Local insertion-only course production with complete teaching stories, professor reviews and preserved lecture slides.

interface.shortDescription: Add complete teaching stories to existing slides.
interface.longDescription: Seven linked skills prepare local sources, write and review causal teaching stories, illustrate only new insertion slides, revise selected images and verify augmented PowerPoints. Supports Windows, macOS and Linux.
capabilities: Dependency preflight and scoped local execution
Windows/Mac PowerPoint and Linux LibreOffice rendering
Complete original teaching stories with optional attributed references
Insertion-only slide plans and iterative professor review
Preserved original lecture slides and notes
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $dreaming-course-preflight to verify dependencies and start the automatic Dreaming Course Pipeline from my course materials.
